pet_notes: Pixel-art chibi desktop pet inspired by Kotori Minami: flaxen hair, amber eyes, iconic side half-up hairstyle with a green ribbon bow, Otonokizaka-style school idol uniform palette with a green neck bow, gentle healing personality with a slightly airheaded charm, compact full-body silhouette, optional tiny attached (bird-like) companion motif or alpaca plush, no text, no logos, no scenery.
style_notes: Minimal cute pixel style, crisp outline, readable when shrunk for a floating desktop pet. Preserve large simple shapes: flax hair mass, amber eyes, green bow, navy-white uniform accents, green neck bow. Use attached props only, never detached symbols or text.
style_contract: Pet-safe sprite: compact full-body mascot, readable in a 192x208 cell, clear silhouette, simple face, stable palette/materials, and crisp edges for chroma-key extraction. Style `pixel`: Pixel-art-adjacent digital mascot with a chunky silhouette, simple dark outline, limited palette, flat cel shading, and visible stepped edges.
